timeline.text: My youngest hasn't started homework yet — the TV gate still treated him like he had chores to finish.
The rule checked every child the same way: all tasks done, or no TV.
In the Cloudflare Worker behind the gate, a child with zero tasks could never pass.
Now kids with no tasks are exempt; a parent can still lock the house down.
Myron now unlocks the TV himself, with his own PIN — no homework needed, even at grade zero.
